items.briefing:
Australian small businesses are being targeted by increasingly convincing AI-generated scams, including fake invoices, phishing emails, and fraudulent supplier requests that are harder than ever to spot. Separately, the Australian Cyber Security Centre has flagged that attackers are actively exploiting vulnerabilities in JetBrains TeamCity servers here in Australia — organisations running this software should apply patches immediately if they haven't already.

These threats are a reminder that both people and software can be entry points for attackers. **Practical tip:** If you receive an unexpected payment request or invoice by email, verify it by calling the supplier directly using a phone number you already have on file — not one provided in the email.

featured.title: AI fuels targeted scams against Australian small firms
featured.summary: Targeted fraud is inflicting bigger losses on small firms as AI helps criminals forge convincing invoices and impersonations in Australia.
